info.title: SharpDetect
info.description: Dynamic analysis framework for .NET. Runs an application or a test suite with a CoreCLR profiler attached and reports observed concurrency issues during the run.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Creates a configuration file for analysis

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path for the configuration file Default: <AnalysisDescriptor.json>.

options.name: --plugin
options.description: Analysis plugin name or plugin type full name. Default: FastTrack.

options.name: --target
options.description: Target application or test assembly (.dll)

options.name: --test
options.description: Treat the target as a test assembly Default: <false>.

options.name: --filter
options.description: Test filter expression (requires --test)

options.name: --runner
options.description: Test runner: Mtp (default) | VsTest (requires --test) Choices: "Mtp", "VsTest".

options.name: --instrument-system-libraries
options.description: Instrument system assemblies (System, Microsoft, test frameworks..) Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-stack-traces
options.description: Report a single frame for racing accesses instead of a stack trace Default: <false>.

options.name: --stack-trace-depth
options.description: Maximum number of frames per collected stack trace. Default: 5.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Console output detail. Default: Normal. Choices: "Quiet", "Normal", "Detailed", "Diagnostic".

options.name: --report
options.description: Report file or folder. Default: SharpDetect_Report_<local time>.html in the current directory.

options.name: --no-report
options.description: Do not write report Default: <false>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: plugins
commands.description: Lists the analysis plugins that can be passed to --plugin

options.name: --plugin-assembly
options.description: Plugin assembly to inspect. Default: the plugins shipped with SharpDetect.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.
